# Performance Results (generated by scripts/perf_study.py)

CoreMark: 2K performance run, 20 iterations, `-O3 -funroll-loops`; scores are per MHz from cycle counts (simulation, so the 10-second rule does not apply).
Dhrystone 2.2 (riscv-tests build, `-O2 -fno-inline`), 2000 runs.

| Config | Description | CoreMark/MHz | CM IPC | DMIPS/MHz | DS IPC | Branch MPKI (CM) | Mispredict rate (CM) | I$ misses (CM) | D$ misses (CM) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| baseline | BP on, 2x4 KiB caches, 1-cycle BRAM | 2.88 | 0.808 | 1.03 | 0.695 | 20.3 | 10.3% | 24354 | 2575 |
| no_bp | branch prediction disabled (predict not-taken) | 2.21 | 0.619 | 0.82 | 0.548 | 109.0 | 55.2% | 25588 | 2575 |
| dram10 | baseline + 10-cycle main memory | 2.46 | 0.688 | 1.02 | 0.652 | 20.3 | 10.3% | 24354 | 2575 |
| dram10_nocache | 10-cycle memory, no caches | 0.23 | 0.064 | 0.09 | 0.062 | 21.2 | 10.7% | 0 | 0 |
| dram10_1k | 10-cycle memory, 1 KiB caches | 1.76 | 0.493 | 0.33 | 0.221 | 20.3 | 10.3% | 70689 | 11956 |
| dram10_16k | 10-cycle memory, 16 KiB caches | 2.98 | 0.832 | 1.02 | 0.672 | 20.3 | 10.3% | 836 | 235 |
| big_bp | 256-entry BTB, 4096-entry gshare | 2.96 | 0.831 | 1.05 | 0.715 | 12.7 | 6.4% | 23588 | 2575 |
